hero.subtitle: विकलांगजनों के लिए समर्पित
hero.body: We are an NGO based in Singrauli, MP. We help PWD get government ID cards, pensions, wheelchairs, and equal opportunities — free of charge.

services.title: How We Help You
services.subtitle: Six ways we support persons with disabilities and their families — all free.

items.title: Get ID Cards
items.desc: We help you make UDID card, disability certificate, and Samagra ID — free.

items.title: Apply for Pension
items.desc: We fill forms and follow up so your monthly pension reaches your bank account.

items.title: Wheelchair / Hearing Aid
items.desc: We help you get free assistive devices through the ADIP government scheme.

items.title: Education & Scholarship
items.desc: We guide students to apply for scholarships and inclusive schools.

items.title: Legal Help
items.desc: Facing discrimination at work or school? We connect you with free legal aid.

items.title: Village Camps
items.desc: We come to your village. No need to travel. Just bring your papers.

impact.title: Our Impact So Far

about.title: Our Story
about.body_1: Aadarsh Viklang Sewa Sangh was started in Singrauli by a group of disability rights activists who saw firsthand how hard it is for PWD to access their rights and government benefits.
about.body_2: We are a registered NGO. Our small dedicated team works across Singrauli, Sidhi, and nearby districts to ensure no person is left behind because of their disability.
about.mission_quote: "To empower every Person with Disability in MP through equal access to rights, government schemes, education, and livelihood opportunities."
